name: mirage
text: The engine isn't off. It switched to a fresh GitHub runner about a minute ago (the normal 6-hour handover) and is scanning now. Its first list takes a few minutes. The one thing not running is the money side: trading and bids are idle because the Vigilant wallet is empty (the last few checks all said so). It will resume on its own once the subaccount has funds. If your app showed it as off, that was most likely the gap during the handover.
